parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description:
The end time of querying the SQL execution plan.   
The value must be UTC time in the format of YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the OceanBase cluster.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description:
The start time of querying the SQL execution plan.   
The value must be UTC time in the format of YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun oceanbasepro describe-oas-sql-details --instance-id ob317v4uif0000 --tenant-id t4louaeei0000 --sql-id 8D6E8400000B8FB1823D199E2CA10000 --db-name test_db --start-time 2023-04-12T04:38:38Z --end-time 2023-04-12T05:38:38Z --dynamic-sql false --parse-table true --region cn-hangzhou
